title: Final rites of Chennamma Deve Gowda at foothills of Ranganatha Swamy Betta at Mavinakere
description: The mortal remains of Chennamma will be brought to Holenarasipur by Sunday (July 19, 2026) evening. The public will be allowed to pay their last respects to her at the residence of former Minister H. D. Revanna in Holenarasipur
